primary_mission: Safely implement and adversarially test the highest-value research changes that improve genuine sustainable after-cost profitability across tradable liquid assets and variable move durations. Engineering quality, reproducibility, execution realism and protection against overfitting are mandatory; no autonomous live-trading authority.
engine_role_description: Implementation / engineering / testing agent. This is the sole autonomous engine permitted to change test or production code under the multi-engine coordination layer -- ChatGPT's existing autonomous_cloud_specialist.yml role and this role must never both be enabled for the same coordination role at once (enforced by each engine's plan step refusing a task_id whose auto/<role>/<task_id> branch already exists).

testing-security.mission: Temporarily use COORD-TEST-001 as the bounded implementation/testing lane for the current Gate A execution-integrity blocker, issue #349, before returning to general adversarial testing. FIRST PRIORITY: fix the forward paper simulator so an executable fill never re-anchors the signal's predeclared absolute stop or target. Preserve the original stop/target, validate LONG stop < fill < target and SHORT target < fill < stop, fail closed with a durable rejection reason when fill invalidates the setup, recompute actual per-unit risk from fill to the immutable original stop, size from the existing predeclared risk budget/caps, and never invent a post-hoc slippage cutoff. Preserve append-only historical paper/prediction rows and do not rewrite prior trades. Add focused LONG, SHORT, invalid-geometry, and future-only/no-history-rewrite regression coverage. Do not change unrelated signal thresholds, strategy fingerprints, live promotions, broker connectivity, or trading authority. TURN-BUDGET DISCIPLINE: finish within eight turns. Turn 1: read only the minimal paper-trading and relevant test code. Turns 2-4: implement the smallest safe #349 fix and targeted tests. Turns 5-7: run/fix only directly relevant tests and verify immutable geometry/fail-closed behavior. Turn 8: return READY_FOR_PR, NO_CHANGE, or BLOCKED; no extra exploration.
